claim: You can retain automated backups for deleted Aurora clusters and restore them to a specified point in time; the document history lists this on August 4, 2023.
question: Can you keep Aurora automated backups after you delete a cluster?

values.display: retain automated backups for deleted Aurora clusters
values.spoken: retain automated backups for deleted clusters

qualifiers.condition: you choose to retain the backups when you delete the cluster

note: Changed recently. Older sources, including the Aurora FAQ, still say automated backups are not kept after an instance is deleted.
